p.PROJECT-SOURCE-IS-MULTI-HOMED: This project's source is **multi-homed**: the same history lives on more than one git host.

p.COPIES-ARE-KEPT-IN-STEP-UNDER-A-SINGLE-W: It is kept in step under a **single-writer** model, so the copies never diverge.

p.THERE-IS-ONE-MAINLINE: There is one **mainline** — the maintainer's integrated local `main`.

p.EVERY-HOST-IS-A-DOWNSTREAM-READ-REPLICA: Every host in the target manifest is a downstream **read-replica** of mainline.

p.HISTORY-REACHES-A-HOST-ONLY-THROUGH-THE-: History reaches a host only through the project's **fan-out** procedure, which is fast-forward-only and never uses `--force`.

p.fanout-mechanics-pointer: Fan-out mechanics and the reference script: @spec://org.vibevm.world/source-mirrors/flows/source-mirrors/fanout-mechanics#root.

facts.COMMIT-ON-MAINLINE-ROLLOUT-IS-A-SEPARATE: Commit on mainline as usual. Rollout to the hosts is a **separate, deliberate** step — the fan-out procedure, run at a natural checkpoint, not a daemon and not `git push` to each host.
facts.A-WEB-UI-MERGE-IS-NOT-INTEGRATED-UNTIL-B: A web-UI merge on a host (a clicked "Merge" button) is **not** integrated until it has been brought home into mainline first; only then does it fan out to the other hosts.
facts.REPORTED-DRIFT-IS-A-SIGNAL-TO-INVESTIGAT: If a host reports **drift** (it carries a `main` mainline does not), treat it as a signal to investigate — fetch, inspect, reconcile *into* mainline, then re-fan. Never overwrite the host to make the warning go away.

facts.NEVER-PUSH-DIRECTLY-TO-A-REPLICA-HOST: Never push directly to a replica host — rollout goes through the fan-out procedure, which is the single source of truth for targets.
facts.NEVER-FORCE-ANY-TARGET: Never `--force` any target, for any ref, for any reason. The fan-out is fast-forward-only by law.
facts.NEVER-RESOLVE-A-DIVERGENCE-BY-CLOBBERING: Never resolve a divergence by clobbering the target. A diverged target is investigated and reconciled into mainline, never silently overwritten.
facts.NEVER-TREAT-A-WEB-UI-MERGE-AS-INTEGRATED: Never treat a web-UI merge as integrated until its commits are in mainline.
